name: twitter

dimensions.name: similarity_to_best
dimensions.description: How similar is this tweet to the author top-performing tweets? Consider topic, structure, tone, length, and content type. If this tweet were placed next to their best work, would it fit? 8-10 = very similar to their best, 3-5 = similar to their average, 0-2 = similar to their worst.

dimensions.name: similarity_to_worst
dimensions.description: How similar is this tweet to the author worst-performing tweets? Vague announcements, filler, no substance. 8-10 = very similar to their worst, 0-2 = nothing like their worst.

probability_guide: If similarity_to_best is 7+ and similarity_to_worst is below 4: output 0.40-0.60 (this matches their winning pattern).
If similarity_to_best is 5-6: output 0.20-0.35 (decent but not their best work).
If similarity_to_best is below 4 and similarity_to_worst is 5+: output 0.05-0.15 (matches their losing pattern).
Base rate is 28% hit. Most tweets should be 15-30%.
If link_penalty context says external URL present: reduce by 0.10.
extra_considerations: The author recent top tweets and worst tweets are shown above. Use pattern matching, not rubric scoring.
What makes their best tweets work? Does this tweet have those same qualities?
What makes their worst tweets fail? Does this tweet share those flaws?
Timing: US business hours (13:00-22:00 UTC) see higher hit rates.
